x: Harry Thaxter is not so busy in his pub. at Diss, Norfolk, now that the Americans have left, and hopes to pay us a visit. We are pleased to say that Harry is feeling much better.
Harry Thaxter sends his best wishes to all his old friends, and will be pleased to see them at the Sun Hotel, Diss, at any time they are in the neighbourhood.

Ruddick, now qualified for our teams and eager to show his undoubted ability on our behalf; to our Chief Coach, George Clay, recently returned from hospital after an operation; to Harry Thaxter, "Mine Host" at The Sun Inn, Diss, Norfolk, who recently sent greetings to all friends; to E.

In this he was nominated as a "B" team man but was able to assist our fourth "A" team man, Harry Thaxter, to complete a Belgrave team win; and was content to finish in 17th position himself, following Thaxter in.
